subject.title: fix(plugins): preserve state on npm metadata failures

question: Should this narrower, strongly proven preservation patch land first with npm 12 parsing tracked separately, or should maintainers consolidate both fixes into one canonical branch?
rationale: The branches overlap at the state-removal owner boundary, but only the competing branch claims the full two-part issue scope; selecting a canonical implementation avoids duplicate policy and determines whether the linked issue can close after merge.

options.title: Consolidate one complete fix
options.body: Choose one branch containing both single-array normalization and non-destructive pre-install failure handling, then close the competing branch.

options.title: Land preservation first
options.body: Merge this branch as the state-loss fix and keep the linked issue open for a separate focused npm 12 parser patch.

recommendation.title: Consolidate one complete fix
recommendation.body: Choose one branch containing both single-array normalization and non-destructive pre-install failure handling, then close the competing branch.
